items.question: The absorption pull veto (max_pull_frac 0.75) is fed by a 100 ms book fold that understates pullFrac; on the raw feed about 19.5 % of passing episodes would be vetoed. The trader has ruled to switch the engine to the raw-equivalent (gross) measure, built after a 7-week holiday. Should the veto threshold also be tightened?

options.label: (a)
options.text: tighten the threshold now, on the current 100 ms measure

options.label: (b)
options.text: no threshold change now; the raw measure itself tightens the veto when it ships; then re-calibrate the threshold on raw-measured data against outcomes, pre-registered

options.label: (c)
options.text: both: tighten now and switch the measure later

items.rationale: 0.75 was set against the biased 100 ms measure. Switching the measure already vetoes ~19.5 % more episodes. Tightening now tunes a threshold on a measure being retired, and (c) would double-tighten when the raw measure lands. Whether more vetoes improve outcomes is unmeasured; the threshold must be re-derived on the raw measure against outcomes.
